noise: Analytically integrated zero-mean Gaussian observation perturbations on real measured trajectories. The supplied R is oracle-known, except explicit quarter/fourfold variance stress. Not measured camera noise.
scope: Retrospective follow-up on already-open DLO4/DLO5. New source-fitted predictive discrepancy covariance, not simulator parameter uncertainty or physical-state updating. No new robot data, no active sensing, no future-free-node conditioning. Initial full state and known clamp inputs inherited equally from old forecasts. Source/target anchors trained on 39/56 source trajectories.
selection: leave-one-complete-source-trajectory-out, equal weight current and +5 frame expected hidden MSE; all source masks/noise scenarios; no target fitting
statistics: Exact expected squared errors over controlled measurement noise; pair and bootstrap whole trajectories within two fixed objects. Current, +5 and +25 reported separately; no target-defined endpoints. The v1 primary failure is not replaced.
target_masks: all non-contiguous subsets of the same cardinality
